name: MyMovement.Space
description:
MyMovement.Space is a personalized training platform for athletes, coaches, and active individuals who want structured, evidence-based programming.

This connector lets Claude build real workout sessions for you, using only exercises from our validated catalog. No AI-invented movements. Every session is grounded in expert-designed programming and can be executed inside the MyMovement.Space app with video demonstrations, muscle mapping, and multi-level logging. 

WHAT CLAUDE CAN DO
• Create personalized training sessions based on your goals, level, and preferences
• Search and select from 100+ expert-validated exercises with technique cues and research references
• Build sessions with sets, reps, duration, tempo, rest, and distance-based stations
• Propose structured workouts you can review before saving

HOW IT WORKS
1. Connect your MyMovement.Space account via secure OAuth (subscription required)
2. Ask Claude to plan a session — e.g. "Build an upper body strength session for me"
3. Review the proposed session in Claude
4. Approved sessions appear in the MyMovement.Space app under Sessions → Coach → MCP
5. Execute with video-guided exercises, logging, and progress tracking

INSIDE MYMOVEMENT.SPACE
The app also includes:
• Juniper — built-in AI coaching assistant (in-app chat, separate from this connector)
• EMOM & AMRAP timed circuit viewers for kettlebell, HYROX-style, and multi-block workouts
• Real-time 3D anatomy viewer (native, on-device)
• Garmin Connect running analytics and running mechanics insights
• Structured programs: Mobility, Return to Sport, Sports Performance, Longevity, and more
• Apple Health sync, external workout logging, and progress analytics

PRIVACY & CONTROL
• User-initiated connection only — you authorize access via our web consent flow
• Claude does not embed inside the iOS app; the app displays sessions you explicitly approved
• Disconnect anytime from Claude settings or MyMovement → Settings → Integrations
• All exercises come from our

_published_faq.name: How do I add MyMovement.Space to Claude, ChatGPT, or Cursor?

acceptedAnswer.text: Add MyMovement.Space to Claude, ChatGPT, or Cursor by connecting its remote MCP URL in each client's MCP settings. In Claude, add a custom connector. In ChatGPT, add an MCP app. In Cursor, add an MCP server under Settings. The MCP URL is https://mcp.mymovement.space/api/mcp. This server requires OAuth, so complete the login prompt after you connect.

_published_faq.name: What tools does the MyMovement.Space MCP server provide?

acceptedAnswer.text: MyMovement.Space provides these MCP tools: create_session, get_progress, and search_exercises.

_published_faq.name: What are the best alternatives to MyMovement.Space?

acceptedAnswer.text: As of October 17, 2026, alternatives to MyMovement.Space in consumer-health on the Manufact MCP catalog include Sweat & Tonic, Vitals Vault, It's Complicated — Therapist Directory, courtsapp, and CheckCells.
MyMovement.Space requires authentication. Connect it in Claude, ChatGPT, or Cursor and complete the OAuth login prompt.
MyMovement.Space is developed by Birken Sports. It is listed as community on the Claude connector directory.
